scope: Only Table 1, MSD and SD. Fixed predictions and explicit run lists.

metrics.aggregation: arithmetic mean of metrics computed independently per run
metrics.test_fpr99: k = ceil(0.99 * malicious_count - 1e-12); threshold is kth largest positive score; flag scores >= threshold; no interpolation; missing review-policy scores become +infinity
metrics.auroc: tie-averaged ranks of finite native scores only
metrics.archived_operating_points: Separate audit only; never substituted for test_fpr99. Judges use their fixed native rule, not a validation-fitted recall gate.

display.seed_std: recall and FPR only, percent, one decimal

msd.judge_model: grok-4.3 (AI/ML API reseller, request id x-ai/grok-4-3)

sd.judge_model: grok-4.3 (AI/ML API reseller, request id x-ai/grok-4-3)
